sentences.en: Where were you, Jennifer, when you heard the news about the leak draft opinion from the Supreme Court?
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗，当你听到最高法院泄露的意见草案的消息时，你在哪里？

sentences.en: And tell me about that moment.
sentences.zh: 能跟我讲讲那个时刻吗？

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: I felt like the air kind of just got knocked out of me because I was, you know, that was the one thing I was kind of still like,
sentences.zh: 我感觉空气好像一下子被抽空了，因为你知道，那是我当时还心存的一点……

sentences.en: okay, all these horrible bills are being signed, but if we could, if a row can just hold, you know, we have a foothold.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所有这些可怕的法案都在被签署，但如果我们能，只要罗诉韦德案能挺住，你知道的，我们就还有立足之地。

sentences.en: And, you know, whenever you're kind of hoping that that's the one thing that's going to save you and then to find out that more than likely it's going to fall was just, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，每当你觉得那是唯一能拯救你的东西，然后却发现它多半要倒台时，那种感觉……

sentences.en: it was almost like, well, that's, that's perfect.
sentences.zh: 简直就像是，好吧，这、这太完美了。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: You know, what are we going to do now?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们现在该怎么办？

sentences.en: You know, everybody's scared.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所有人都害怕。

sentences.en: Every single person that walks in our clinic, you can see the fear
sentences.zh: 每一个走进我们诊所的人，你都能看出那种恐惧

sentences.en: on their faces.
sentences.zh: 写在他们的脸上。

sentences.en: So as of last week in Oklahoma, we cannot go above six weeks.
sentences.zh: 因此，截至上周在俄克拉荷马州，我们不能超过六周。

sentences.en: There's the SB 612.
sentences.zh: 这就是参议院第 612 号法案（SB 612）。

sentences.en: So that's going to make it a felony for any doctor to perform abortion in Oklahoma at any stage.
sentences.zh: 所以这使得俄克拉荷马州的任何医生在任何阶段实施堕胎都将成为重罪。

sentences.en: And so we had women coming in knowing that they may be the last patients that will get their abortion in our clinic.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们有女性来这里时就知道，她们可能是最后能在我们诊所做堕胎手术的患者了。

sentences.en: And it was just fear because they're like, what if this happens again?
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是恐惧，因为她们在想，如果这种情况再次发生怎么办？

sentences.en: What am I supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么办？

sentences.en: So in a way, Roe was your life raft.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，《罗诉韦德案》曾是你们的救生筏。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Did it mean, you know, this, this bill that's bans it entirely?
sentences.zh: 这意味着，你知道，这个完全禁止它的法案……

sentences.en: Did you think about yourself,
sentences.zh: 你想过你自己吗，

sentences.en: Jennifer, that you could potentially be charged with a felony?
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗，你可能会被控重罪？

sentences.en: I mean, just by doing this work?
sentences.zh: 我是说，仅仅因为做这份工作？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I've definitely, you know, I've thought about it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，我当然，你知道，我想过。

sentences.en: And I definitely know that I'm part of that.
sentences.zh: 而且我非常清楚我是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: But I just feel like, if that's what's going to have to happen to me to continue to give these women the support they need, then I'll take it.
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得，如果为了继续给这些女性她们所需的支持，我必须经历这些，那我就认了。

sentences.en: What's going to happen is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 该发生的事总会发生。

sentences.en: I'll take whatever's going to come from it.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的任何结果我都接受。

sentences.zh: 今天是 5 月 11 日，星期三。

sentences.en: Susan, where were you when you first heard about the leak from the Supreme
sentences.zh: 苏珊，当你第一次听到最高法院泄露的消息时，你在哪里？

sentences.en: Court, the draft opinion on the Mississippi case?
sentences.zh: 关于密西西比州案的意见草案？

sentences.en: I was here at my home.
sentences.zh: 我当时在我家里。

sentences.en: I was in bed, just scrolling.
sentences.zh: 我躺在床上，只是在刷手机。

sentences.en: That's my quiet time and I don't have to wake up my husband and all that.
sentences.zh: 那是我的安静时光，我不必吵醒丈夫什么的。

sentences.en: I just remember reading that and I was, I'm just devastated.
sentences.zh: 我只记得读到那个消息时，我……我简直崩溃了。

sentences.en: But it's just like one blow after another.
sentences.zh: 但这就好像是一记又一记的打击。

sentences.en: It's like I can't.
sentences.zh: 就像我承受不住一样。

sentences.en: You know, it's just like being in a prize fight and getting one knocked down after another.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就像是在打一场拳击赛，一次又一次被击倒。

sentences.en: And it's just really sad.
sentences.zh: 这真的让人很难过。

sentences.en: My name is Dr. Susan Dodd.
sentences.zh: 我叫苏珊·多德医生。

sentences.en: I'm a board certified OBGYN doctor who practiced my career in Knoxville,
sentences.zh: 我是一名获得委员会认证的妇产科医生，我的职业生涯主要在田纳西州

sentences.en: Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 诺克斯维尔度过。

sentences.en: So I finished working there about a year ago.
sentences.zh: 所以我大约在一年前在那里结束了工作。

sentences.en: I'm 67 and enjoying retirement.
sentences.zh: 我今年 67 岁，正在享受退休生活。

sentences.en: So Susan, tell me a little bit about your background.
sentences.zh: 苏珊，跟我讲讲你的背景吧。

sentences.en: Did you grow up in Tennessee?
sentences.zh: 你是在田纳西州长大的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I grew up in Gatlinburg, Tennessee, which is right at the foot of the Smunky Mountains
sentences.zh: 是的，我在田纳西州加特林堡长大，那里就在大雾山

sentences.en: National Park.
sentences.zh: 国家公园的山脚下。

sentences.en: That's Dolly Parton territory, right?
sentences.zh: 那是多莉·帕顿的地盘，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, Dolly Parton used to babysit me.
sentences.zh: 哦，多莉·帕顿以前经常照顾我。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But anyway, I always enjoyed school and I also enjoyed my boyfriend probably a little too much.
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，我一直很喜欢上学，可能也有点太喜欢我的男朋友了。

sentences.en: And at age 16, our condom failed.
sentences.zh: 在 16 岁那年，我们的避孕套破了。

sentences.en: And when I found out to my dismay that I was pregnant and I wanted to go on to college,
sentences.zh: 当我沮丧地发现自己怀孕了，而我又想继续上大学时，

sentences.en: my older sister came into town and we found a doctor in Knoxville who was doing abortions illegally in his clinic.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐来到了镇上，我们在诺克斯维尔找到了一位在他的诊所里非法实施堕胎的医生。

sentences.en: What year would that have been, Susan?
sentences.zh: 那是哪一年，苏珊？

sentences.en: That was, let's see, I was 16, I'm 67, 1972, the year before.
sentences.zh: 那是，让我想想，我 16 岁，我现在 67 岁，1972 年，前一年。

sentences.en: So the year before Roe.
sentences.zh: 也就是《罗诉韦德案》前的一年。

sentences.en: Roe, right.
sentences.zh: 《罗诉韦德案》，没错。

sentences.en: But I went to see him in Knoxville.
sentences.zh: 但我去诺克斯维尔找了他。

sentences.en: My sister took me and told the doctor I was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐带我去的，并告诉医生我怀孕了。

sentences.en: Uh, he did a gynecologic exam and said, yes, you're fairly early.
sentences.zh: 呃，他做了妇科检查，说，是的，时间还挺早的。

sentences.en: You'll come back at five o'clock.
sentences.zh: 你五点钟回来。

sentences.en: And he told me how much money to bring.
sentences.zh: 他还告诉我带多少钱。

sentences.en: And, uh,
sentences.zh: 然后，呃……

sentences.en: How much was it?
sentences.zh: 多少钱？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It was a lot in the 1970s dollars.
sentences.zh: 在 20 世纪 70 年代的物价里，这是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Uh, so, uh, my boyfriend helped me out at that point.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以，呃，我男朋友当时帮了我。

sentences.en: He asked us to come back after the clinic had closed.
sentences.zh: 他让我们在诊所关门后来。

sentences.en: We did so.
sentences.zh: 我们照做了。

sentences.en: Was it scary?
sentences.zh: 很吓人吗？

sentences.en: Oh, it was scary as hell.
sentences.zh: 哦，吓死人了。

sentences.en: It was my first gynecologic experience and it was pretty traumatic.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次经历妇科检查，而且相当痛苦。

sentences.en: It hurt quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 挺疼的。

sentences.en: Of course, back then you didn't have any anesthesia at all.
sentences.zh: 当然，那时候你根本没有任何麻醉。

sentences.en: My sister told me she was in the waiting room waiting and she said, I heard you screaming and almost came back.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐告诉我她在候诊室等着，她说，我听到你在尖叫，差点就冲进去了。

sentences.en: I said, well, yeah, it really hurt.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，是的，真的很疼。

sentences.en: But he knew what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 但他知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: He did it very well.
sentences.zh: 他做得非常好。

sentences.en: I suffered no consequences.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何后遗症。

sentences.en: And I was, uh, kind of a naive 16 year old, but it changed the course of my life.
sentences.zh: 而且我当时是个有点天真的 16 岁女孩，但这改变了我人生的轨迹。

sentences.en: I would not have had the opportunity to go on to college.
sentences.zh: 我本没有机会继续上大学。

sentences.en: Would you have been the first generation to go to college?
sentences.zh: 你们是第一代上大学的人吗？

sentences.en: You and your sisters?
sentences.zh: 你和你的姐妹们？

sentences.en: Oh, we were in our family for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，在我们家族里绝对是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't think my dad ever finished eighth grade.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我爸爸连八年级都没读完。

sentences.en: I'm not sure he could read.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不确定他会不会识字。

sentences.en: My mother had to fight her mother to finish high school.
sentences.zh: 我母亲不得不与她的母亲抗争才读完高中。

sentences.en: Her mother didn't see any reason for girls to get educated.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲认为女孩没有必要接受教育。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So this was incredibly important to you.
sentences.zh: 所以这对你来说极其重要。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Susan, what did this mean for your life, this experience?
sentences.zh: 苏珊，这段经历对你的生活意味着什么？

sentences.en: How did it change you?
sentences.zh: 它如何改变了你？

sentences.en: Yeah, it defined my whole life.
sentences.zh: 是的，它定义了我的一生。

sentences.en: It's the reason I became an OBGYN.
sentences.zh: 这就是我成为妇产科医生的原因。

sentences.en: I finished my residency in 1987 and joined a group of older doctors at the University of Tennessee Hospital in Knoxville.
sentences.zh: 我在 1987 年完成了住院医师实习，并加入了诺克斯维尔田纳西大学医院的一群老医生。

sentences.en: In 2009, a main abortion provider in Knoxville, Tennessee had a hemorrhagic stroke and tragically died.
sentences.zh: 2009 年，田纳西州诺克斯维尔的一名主要堕胎服务提供者突发出血性中风，不幸离世。

sentences.en: And when Dr. Campbell passed away, there was no other doctor performing abortions in Knoxville.
sentences.zh: 在坎贝尔医生去世后，诺克斯维尔没有其他医生实施堕胎手术了。

sentences.en: And I felt very strongly that the women of East Tennessee needed an option that they didn't need to be driving hundreds of miles to have a termination of a pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 我强烈地感觉到，东田纳西州的女性需要一个选择，她们不需要为了终止妊娠而开车行驶数百英里。

sentences.en: And I explained this to my then partners and said, I'm going to go over to the clinic on my days off and perform abortions.
sentences.zh: 我向当时的合伙人们解释了这一点，并说：“我要在休息日去诊所实施堕胎手术。”

sentences.en: And I would like you to join me.
sentences.zh: “我希望你们能加入我。”

sentences.en: But what happened was the community outrage at abortion made every OBGYN in town
sentences.zh: 但结果是，社区对堕胎的愤怒让城里的每一位妇产科医生

sentences.en: afraid to do them.
sentences.zh: 都害怕去做手术。

sentences.en: Other partners got together and they decided that going over to the abortion clinic was not good for our reputation in the community.
sentences.zh: 其他合伙人聚在一起，他们认为去堕胎诊所对我们在社区的声誉不利。

sentences.en: And they instructed me to stop.
sentences.zh: 他们命令我停止。

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我没有停。

sentences.en: And they fired me.
sentences.zh: 他们把我解雇了。

sentences.en: So in 2009, after practicing with a group for 25 years, I was out of the group and I continued at Knoxville Center for Reproductive Health, where Dr. Campbell had had his practice.
sentences.zh: 所以在 2009 年，在与一个团队行医 25 年后，我被踢出了团队，但我继续留在坎贝尔医生曾开诊所的诺克斯维尔生殖健康中心工作。

sentences.en: Do you remember any patients that you provided abortions for?
sentences.zh: 你还记得你为哪些患者做过堕胎手术吗？

sentences.en: Kind of a moment that really sticks in your memory?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪个时刻真的深深刻在你的记忆里？

sentences.en: Oh, every patient I saw at the clinic.
sentences.zh: 哦，我在诊所见过的每一位患者我都记得。

sentences.en: So many of them had so many sad stories about, this is why I'm doing this doc.
sentences.zh: 她们当中有太多人都有着令人伤心的故事，比如：“医生，这就是我为什么要这样做。”

sentences.en: And, you know, I have three kids at home.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，“我在家里有三个孩子。”

sentences.en: My husband and I are working full time.
sentences.zh: “我和丈夫都在全职工作。”

sentences.en: Our birth control failed.
sentences.zh: “我们的避孕失败了。”

sentences.en: I can barely feed the three I have.
sentences.zh: “我快养不起现有的这三个孩子了。”

sentences.en: You can just go through story after story after story.
sentences.zh: 你可以一个接一个地讲述这些故事。

sentences.en: These women are doing it for the children they already have, for the commitments they already have, for the future they have planned.
sentences.zh: 这些女性这样做是为了她们已经拥有的孩子，为了她们已经承担的责任，为了她们规划的未来。

sentences.en: And to me, abortion is a part of women's reproductive health.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，堕胎是女性生殖健康的一部分。

sentences.en: Susan, has the environment become more hostile?
sentences.zh: 苏珊，大环境变得更加敌对了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: A lot more.
sentences.zh: 严峻得多。

sentences.en: The protesters would be there.
sentences.zh: 抗议者会守在那里。

sentences.en: They'd be getting my license plate.
sentences.zh: 他们会记下我的车牌号。

sentences.en: They would, I would get threatening letters.
sentences.zh: 他们会……我会收到威胁信。

sentences.en: You know, mostly they were based on, religiously, I was going to go to hell and that I would regret this all my life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它们基本上是基于宗教原因，觉得我要下地狱，我会为此后悔一生。

sentences.en: And that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的话。

sentences.en: I got outdoor lighting for my home so that people couldn't hide in the bushes and so on.
sentences.zh: 我为家里安装了户外照明，这样人们就没法藏在灌木丛里了之类的。

sentences.en: So it really affected our lives.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实影响了我们的生活。

sentences.en: My husband, my husband bought me a bulletproof veSt.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫，我丈夫给我买了一件防弹背心。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because going into the clinic, I was afraid I would get shot.
sentences.zh: 因为去诊所时，我怕自己会被枪击。

sentences.en: And I was real good.
sentences.zh: 而且我练得很熟练。

sentences.en: Did you wear it?
sentences.zh: 你穿了吗？

sentences.en: The FBI.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: Every time I went to the clinic.
sentences.zh: 每次我去诊所都穿。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: How often did you go to the clinic?
sentences.zh: 你多久去一次诊所？

sentences.en: Twice a week.
sentences.zh: 一周两次。

sentences.en: Susan, did you think it would get like this, end up like this?
sentences.zh: 苏珊，你曾觉得事情会变成这样、以这种结局收场吗？

sentences.en: I almost feel like it's kind of like a funny trick on the protesters, if that makes sense.

sentences.en: My name is Dr. David Eisenberg.
sentences.zh: 我叫大卫·艾森伯格医生。

sentences.en: I'm a board certified obstetrician gynecologist and I provide abortion care in the St. Louis metropolitan area.
sentences.zh: 我是一名获得委员会认证的妇产科医生，我在圣路易斯大都会区提供堕胎护理。

sentences.en: I've been involved in abortion care and reproductive health issues since I started medical school in Birmingham, Alabama,
sentences.zh: 自从我在亚拉巴马州伯明翰开始读医学院起，我就一直参与堕胎护理和生殖健康问题，

sentences.en: and worked as a volunteer patient escort at the Planned Parenthood there.
sentences.zh: 并在那里的计划生育诊所担任志愿患者护送员。

sentences.en: For the last three years, we have been living with the reality that people are now like waking up to,
sentences.zh: 在过去三年里，我们一直生活在一个人们现在才开始意识到的现实中，

sentences.en: which is because of the regulatory burden in the state of Missouri and because of the persecution that happened the spring of 2019,
sentences.zh: 那就是由于密苏里州的监管负担，以及2019年春季发生的迫害事件，

sentences.en: the Planned Parenthood of the St. Louis region in southwest Missouri spent time and money building out a new space in southern Illinois
sentences.zh: 圣路易斯地区及密苏里州西南部的计划生育协会花费时间和资金在伊利诺伊州南部建立了一个新空间，

sentences.en: to take care of the Missouri patients who needed us.
sentences.zh: 以便照顾那些需要我们的密苏里州患者。

sentences.en: And we knew we would eventually not be able to provide care for in Missouri.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就知道，我们终将无法在密苏里州提供护理。

sentences.en: And so 99% of the abortion care that our Planned Parenthood affiliate provides and has provided since early 2020, late 2019, has been in southern Illinois.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的计划生育分支机构提供以及自2020年初、2019年末以来一直提供的99%的堕胎护理，都在伊利诺伊州南部进行。

sentences.en: And because of the volume, I am no longer providing outpatient abortion care in the state of Missouri.
sentences.zh: 由于业务量大，我不再在密苏里州提供门诊堕胎护理。

sentences.en: All of the outpatient abortion care that I provide is now in the state of Illinois.
sentences.zh: 我提供的所有门诊堕胎护理现在都在伊利诺伊州。

sentences.en: And one of the things that has come up over and over again since the Supreme Court draft decision was leaked
sentences.zh: 自从最高法院的裁决草案被泄露以来，有一件事反复出现，

sentences.en: is people reaching out to me and saying, David, what are we going to do?
sentences.zh: 那就是人们找到我并说：大卫，我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: What do we do when Roe falls?
sentences.zh: 当《罗诉韦德案》倒台时我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: My answer is what we have been doing.
sentences.zh: 我的回答是：我们一直在做的事。

sentences.en: What makes me angry, what I'm resentful about is how far we've gone backwards and that we are going at a faster pace.
sentences.zh: 让我愤怒、让我怨恨的是我们倒退得有多远，以及我们倒退的速度正在加快。

sentences.en: David, a lot of the people we've been talking to on the other side are talking a lot about, you know,
sentences.zh: 大卫，我们在另一方听到很多人都在谈论，你知道的，

sentences.en: social services, that the end of Roe will mean lots more women will need more help with funding, help with getting apartments, help with getting diapers,
sentences.zh: 社会服务，认为《罗诉韦德案》的结束将意味着会有更多的女性需要更多的资金帮助、租房帮助、纸尿裤帮助，

sentences.en: because lots more women will be having, carrying their pregnancies to term.
sentences.zh: 因为会有更多的女性将把妊娠进行到底并生下孩子。

sentences.en: I'm interested what you think of that.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你对此的看法。

sentences.en: I think it's disingenuous.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是虚伪的。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Because if people really cared about the children that come from these pregnancies, then we would have universal pre-K.
sentences.zh: 因为如果人们真的关心这些怀孕所带来的孩子，那我们就会有全民学前教育。

sentences.en: We would have health care be a right and not a privilege in this country.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，医疗保健应当是一项权利，而不是特权。

sentences.en: And that you don't just qualify for Medicaid when you're pregnant, but even when you're not.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是在你怀孕时才有资格获得医疗援助，甚至在没有怀孕时也应该有。

sentences.en: If we really cared about the outcome of every single pregnancy,
sentences.zh: 如果我们真的关心每一次怀孕的结果，

sentences.en: we would make sure that people had paid maternity and paternity leave available to them that did not jeopardize their future.
sentences.zh: 我们会确保人们能够获得带薪的产假和陪产假，而不会危及他们的未来。

sentences.en: If people really valued families and children and the people who bear those children, then all of those other things would already be in place.
sentences.zh: 如果人们真的珍视家庭、孩子以及孕育那些孩子的人，那么所有这些其他的保障本该早就已经具备了。

sentences.en: But this is not about the children that may or may not come from a pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是为了那些可能出生也可能不出生在这一妊娠过程中的孩子。

sentences.en: This is about the status of women and whether they are full, capable, society equals to men.
sentences.zh: 这是关于女性的地位，以及她们是否是与男性完全平等、有能力的社会成员。

sentences.en: You know, there's nothing black or white about this.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这根本没有什么绝对的黑白之分。

sentences.en: I acknowledge that if someone chooses to not continue a pregnancy, that is ending the possibility of a child.
sentences.zh: 我承认，如果有人选择不继续妊娠，那确实是终结了一个孩子的可能性。

sentences.en: That is ending the possibility of life.
sentences.zh: 那是在终结生命的可能。

sentences.en: I'm not discounting that.
sentences.zh: 我并没有忽视这一点。

sentences.en: I value the lives of my children and all of the children who have been brought to bear.
sentences.zh: 我珍视我的孩子们的生命，以及所有已经降生到世上的孩子们的生命。

sentences.en: But it's not up to me.
sentences.zh: 但这不由我决定。

sentences.en: I'm not the one who has to carry that pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 我不是那个必须承受这怀孕过程的人。

sentences.en: I'm not the one who has to put food on the table and clothe that child and make sure they're healthy.
sentences.zh: 我不是那个必须挣钱糊口、给孩子穿衣并确保他们健康的人。

sentences.en: My job, and I believe every person's job in this world, is to be a nice person and to be respectful of each other
sentences.zh: 我的工作，而且我认为世界上每个人的工作，都是做一个好人，彼此尊重，

sentences.en: and to give each other grace and, you know, respect their wishes and desires.
sentences.zh: 并且给予彼此包容，你知道的，尊重他们的愿望和诉求。

sentences.en: And I recognize there are people out there who believe that life begins at some specific moment in time.
sentences.zh: 我明白有这样一些人，他们坚信生命在某个特定的时间点就已经开始了。

sentences.en: But I expect them to respect my belief that they can choose to opt out of abortion care and abortion experiences, if that's their worldview.
sentences.zh: 但我希望他们能够尊重我的信念，即如果那是他们的世界观，他们可以选择不参与堕胎护理和堕胎经历。

sentences.en: I choose to opt into it.
sentences.zh: 我选择参与其中。

sentences.en: I am a conscientious provider.
sentences.zh: 我是一名有良知的医疗服务提供者。

sentences.en: It is a part of my moral and, you know, religious worldview.
sentences.zh: 这是我的道德观的一部分，也是你懂的，我的宗教世界观的一部分。

sentences.en: The person who's pregnant knows what's best for them.
sentences.zh: 怀孕的人最清楚什么对他们自己最好。

sentences.en: And that I am trained and capable to provide them whatever aspect of care they need for that pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 而我接受过培训，有能力为他们提供他们该次怀孕所需的任何方面的护理。

sentences.en: So, Jessica, by the way, is it okay if I call you Jess?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，杰西，我叫你杰西可以吗？

sentences.en: Do you prefer Dr. Rubino?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢被称为鲁比诺医生吗？

sentences.en: How do you prefer I address you?
sentences.zh: 你希望我怎么称呼你？

sentences.en: Jess is fine.
sentences.zh: 叫杰西就行。

sentences.en: I really, it's fine.
sentences.zh: 我真的，怎么都行。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay, so I'm Dr. Jessica Rubino and I work at Austin Women's Health Center.
sentences.zh: 好的，我是杰西卡·鲁比诺医生，我在奥斯汀妇女健康中心工作。

sentences.en: I've been there for about four years.
sentences.zh: 我在那儿工作大约四年了。

sentences.en: I've been doing abortions for a little bit longer than that, almost five years, I think, at this point.
sentences.zh: 我做堕胎手术的时间比这稍微长一点，我想现在差不多五年了。

sentences.en: I am going to be 37 years old this summer and have been just practicing under all those other restrictions that made me mad,
sentences.zh: 我今年夏天就37岁了，一直在所有那些让我抓狂的限制规定下行医，

sentences.en: the 24-hour waiting period, and the script of things that aren't true and blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 24小时等待期，还有那些不实之词的医疗话术，等等等等。

sentences.en: And that all lasted until September.
sentences.zh: 这一切一直持续到九月。

sentences.en: And then September started and we entered a new kind of hell.
sentences.zh: 然后九月开始了，我们进入了一种新的地狱。

sentences.en: We are only allowed to provide roughly up until six weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们只被允许大致在孕期六周以内提供服务。

sentences.en: And that's SBA, the six-week ban, right, Jess?
sentences.zh: 也就是SBA，六周禁令，对吧，杰西？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So not only do we have to wade through the stress of feeling like, okay, are you too far?
sentences.zh: 所以，我们不仅要承受这种感觉带来的压力：好吧，你是不是月份太大了？

sentences.en: Are you not?
sentences.zh: 还是没有？

sentences.en: I'm about to tell you, which is going to have some big implications for your life and what you have to do over the next few weeks if you're going to get an abortion.
sentences.zh: 我马上要告诉你这个消息，这会对你的生活以及如果你打算做流产在接下来几周必须要做的事情产生重大影响。

sentences.en: But even if they are okay and they're under the limit and I say, yes, I can see you,
sentences.zh: 但即使她们情况符合且在期限之内，并且我说，可以，我能为你接诊，

sentences.en: even them, they are like, okay, well, I don't know if I even want to have an abortion yet.
sentences.zh: 即使是她们，也会觉得，好吧，我甚至不知道自己现在是不是真的想要做流产。

sentences.en: Some patients have told us that they feel so rushed in their choice,
sentences.zh: 一些患者告诉我们，她们在做选择时感到非常仓促，

sentences.en: but they had to come to the clinic to get their consultation just in case because we also have the 24-hour waiting period.
sentences.zh: 但她们不得不来诊所进行咨询以防万一，因为我们还有24小时的等待期规定。

sentences.en: I had a patient yesterday who said, I wish I could just be in peace while I'm making this decision because right now every social media feed everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我昨天有个患者说，我希望自己在做这个决定的时候能求得一丝平静，因为现在到处都是社交媒体的信息流。

sentences.en: This is everywhere, and I just happen to be pregnant during this time.
sentences.zh: 到处都是，而我偏偏在这个时候怀孕了。

sentences.en: And she's someone that I'm going to be able to see.
sentences.zh: 而她是我能够接诊的患者。

sentences.en: She's early enough, but it's still so overwhelming for her to try to actually know what she really wants to do aside from all the crap around us.
sentences.zh: 她的孕周还够早，但要在我们身边的所有这些烂事之外，弄清楚自己真正想做什么，对她来说依然是压力巨大。

sentences.en: Jess, what happens when a patient comes to you and you have to tell them that they're beyond six weeks?
sentences.zh: 杰西，当一个患者来找你，而你不得不告诉她们已经超过六周时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Once I tell them that they're beyond six weeks, that they're past the point, some patients just sit up and swear a lot.
sentences.zh: 一旦我告诉她们已经超过六周，已经过了那个时间点，有些患者就会直接坐起来，然后狠狠地爆粗口。

sentences.en: And they're like, it's not at you.
sentences.zh: 然后她们会说，我不是冲你发火。

sentences.en: I just can't believe that this is even happening.
sentences.zh: 我只是不敢相信这居然真的发生了。

sentences.en: And there's just so much disbelief.
sentences.zh: 那种难以置信的情绪实在是太强烈了。

sentences.en: Other patients, it's complete fear.
sentences.zh: 还有一些患者，则是完全陷入了恐惧。

sentences.en: And you know, like they're in a situation where they are probably not going to be able to get out.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像她们处在一种可能无法摆脱的困境中。

sentences.en: This is completely changing their life.
sentences.zh: 这彻底改变了她们的人生。

sentences.en: And I had a patient who just sat up and started crying the other day and said, well, I mean, if I don't get an abortion, my partner said they're going to kill me.
sentences.zh: 前几天有个患者坐起来就开始哭，说，好吧，我是说，如果我不去做流产，我的伴侣说他会杀了我的。

sentences.en: What am I supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么办？

sentences.en: And what am I supposed to tell them?
sentences.zh: 我又该对他们说什么？

sentences.en: I can't offer you the appropriate medical care in this situation if that's what you want.
sentences.zh: 如果这是你想要的，在这种情况下我无法为你提供合适的医疗护理。

sentences.en: If you want to terminate your pregnancy in this situation for your safety, you don't have the ability to do that.
sentences.zh: 如果你为了自身安全想在这种情况下终止妊娠，你没有这个能力做到。

sentences.en: So she matters so much less than the pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 所以，比起那个孕妇，她受到的重视实在是太少了。

sentences.en: What did you say to her?
sentences.zh: 你对她说了什么？

sentences.en: I literally like, okay, I have resources.
sentences.zh: 我简直就像是，好吧，我有资源。

sentences.en: Take a few breaths.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸几次。

sentences.en: Let's not give up.
sentences.zh: 我们先别放弃。

sentences.en: Here's what we need to do.
sentences.zh: 这是我们需要做的。

sentences.en: And then I'm able, at least currently, I'm able to give her resources to get one legally outside of the state.
sentences.zh: 然后我能够——至少目前可以——为她提供资源，让她去州外合法进行流产。

sentences.en: And so I literally have a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 所以我手里真的有一张纸。

sentences.en: Here's the funding organizations I recommend calling.
sentences.zh: 这是我建议致电的资金援助机构。

sentences.en: Here's the clinic I recommend you get an appointment with.
sentences.zh: 这是我建议你预约的诊所。

sentences.en: And for someone who's just disclosed something like that, her brain is in three other places and she's freaking out.
sentences.zh: 对于一个刚透露了这种事的人来说，她的脑子在想着好几个其他的事情，她已经吓坏了。

sentences.en: But I also, I have to bring her back down to earth a little bit in that moment and be like, okay, but what are we going to do practically?
sentences.zh: 但在那一刻，我也必须把她稍微拉回现实，对她说，好吧，但我们在现实中该怎么做？

sentences.en: What are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 你打算怎么做？

sentences.en: Here are the steps.
sentences.zh: 步骤如下。

sentences.en: Like, don't go to Louisiana unless you have extra time because it just requires multiple visits.
sentences.zh: 比如，除非你有额外的时间，否则不要去路易斯安那州，因为那里要求多次面诊。

sentences.en: They don't have a lot of clinics.
sentences.zh: 他们没有太多的诊所。

sentences.en: Oklahoma, as of now, I'm telling patients this week, it's illegal.
sentences.zh: 就目前而言，我这周对患者说，俄克拉荷马州是违法的。

sentences.en: Don't go there.
sentences.zh: 不要去那里。

sentences.en: So everybody I'm telling is to go to New Mexico.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉所有人去新墨西哥州。

sentences.en: And there are multiple clinics there, but I give them a name of one.
sentences.zh: 那里有多家诊所，但我只给她们推荐其中一家。

sentences.en: But I'm like, but it may be several weeks wait.
sentences.zh: 但我会说，可能需要等好几周。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: They're getting very busy, but they will do their beSt.
sentences.zh: 他们现在非常忙，但他们会尽力而为的。

sentences.en: And I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我也不清楚。

sentences.en: Like, I'm not on the other side of it.
sentences.zh: 毕竟我不在那边。

sentences.en: So I hear that as far as I know, patients are, like, some are really being helped.
sentences.zh: 所以我听说的情况是，据我所知，有些患者确实得到了很大的帮助。

sentences.en: But I am sort of stuck in my clinic world of seeing all of the patients trying to determine if they're early, if they're, you know, too far.
sentences.zh: 但我有点被困在我的诊所世界里，只能接待所有的患者，努力判断她们的孕周是否还早，还是说，你知道的，已经太迟了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like you're watching kind of the doors closing in real time and having to game it out like some, I don't know, army general or something.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就好比你在实时看着大门关上，然后不得不像某种，我不知道，陆军将军一样去运筹帷幄。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We have patients who, I had one two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 我们有这样的患者，我两周前就遇到过一个。

sentences.en: That day was really, really hard to be a provider.
sentences.zh: 那一天作为一名医护人员，真的非常非常难熬。

sentences.en: It was when she said, but this pregnancy wasn't a choice.
sentences.zh: 当时她说，但这次怀孕根本不是我的选择。

sentences.en: I was raped.
sentences.zh: 我被强暴了。

sentences.en: And I want it out now.
sentences.zh: 我现在就要把它弄掉。

sentences.en: And I can't do it for her.
sentences.zh: 而我无法为她做这个手术。

sentences.en: And I can show her where to go legally.
sentences.zh: 我只能指引她去哪里合法进行。

sentences.en: How long I'm even able to do that is questionable.
sentences.zh: 至于我还能这样做多久都是个未知数。

sentences.en: Is there aiding in a Benny going to be a problem?
sentences.zh: 协助堕胎会成为一个问题吗？

sentences.en: And what do I tell her?
sentences.zh: 我又该对她说什么？

sentences.en: I told her, I am a survivor.
sentences.zh: 我对她说，我也是一名幸存者。

sentences.en: I know how you feel.
sentences.zh: 我懂你的感受。

sentences.en: But I need you to take some deep breaths.
sentences.zh: 但我需要你深呼吸。

sentences.en: We need to get you some help.
sentences.zh: 我们需要为你找点帮助。

sentences.en: Here are resources.
sentences.zh: 这些是资源。

sentences.en: Like, we have to get back to Earth from the trauma that you're in right now.
sentences.zh: 就像，我们必须从你现在身处的心灵创伤中回到现实中来。

sentences.en: And that is awful.
sentences.zh: 这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: That, like, she needs space to be taken care of and told that she's more important than that pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 她需要空间来得到照顾，并被告知她比那个胎儿更重要。

sentences.en: And that is not what she's getting right now.
sentences.zh: 而这正是她现在所没有得到的。

sentences.en: That's really, I mean, it's absolutely, I mean, it's awful.
sentences.zh: 这真的，我的意思是，绝对，我是说，这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And my job has become awful.
sentences.zh: 我的工作也变得糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: Were you a survivor of rape?
sentences.zh: 你是强暴幸存者吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Do you feel comfortable talking to us about it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得跟我们谈论这个可以吗？

sentences.en: Or would you rather not?
sentences.zh: 还是说你宁愿不谈？

sentences.en: Yeah, actually, I'm okay with that.
sentences.zh: 对，其实我没问题。

sentences.en: You know, I've actually traveled down to Mexico to study medical Spanish at one point during medical school.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我曾经在医学院期间去过墨西哥学习医学西班牙语。

sentences.en: And it was someone that I knew.
sentences.zh: 那是认识的人干的。

sentences.en: It was basically, I was just attacked.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我就是被袭击了。

sentences.en: So it was a pretty brutal experience.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一次相当残暴的经历。

sentences.en: And so at the time, I was worried about, like, physical damage down there.
sentences.zh: 当时，我担心的是下面会不会有什么身体上的损伤。

sentences.en: I did a full exam.
sentences.zh: 我做了全面的检查。

sentences.en: And then I tested myself for pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 然后我给自己做了怀孕检测。

sentences.en: And I consider, I feel just really lucky that I didn't get pregnant from that encounter.
sentences.zh: 我真的很庆幸自己在那次遭遇中没有怀孕。

sentences.en: I knew exactly what that patient was talking about when she said how that would feel something, like, from that person inside your body.
sentences.zh: 当那个患者说那种感觉就像是有那样一个人的东西在你体内时，我完全明白她在说什么。

sentences.en: It's just an appalling thought.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个让人毛骨悚然的想法。

sentences.en: I feel that in the pit of my stomach.
sentences.zh: 我一想到就揪心。

sentences.en: But throughout that process of being in the hospital, being examined, I had good doctors here and there.
sentences.zh: 但在医院待着、接受检查的整个过程中，我时常能遇到好医生。

sentences.en: But the vast majority were just sort of seemed uncomfortable and sort of embarrassed to ask me the questions and talk to me about it.
sentences.zh: 但绝大多数人似乎都有些不自在，问我问题和跟我谈论此事时显得有些尴尬。

sentences.en: And I just wasn't, I didn't feel like a whole person.
sentences.zh: 我当时感觉不到自己是一个完整的个人。

sentences.en: And I felt like they were like, well, let's get in your pelvis and figure out if we need to treat anything.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们就像是，好吧，让我们检查一下你的骨盆，看看需不需要治疗什么。

sentences.en: We'll get out of there.
sentences.zh: 弄完我们就走。

sentences.en: Okay, goodbye.
sentences.zh: 好了，再见。

sentences.en: And I was like, that's not, that's not really healing for me as a person like that.
sentences.zh: 当时我想的是，对我作为一个人来说，这根本算不上什么治愈。

sentences.en: I am a whole person and not just that area of my body.
sentences.zh: 我是一个完整的人，而不仅仅是我身体的那个部位。

sentences.en: And so that is the part that I, I try to get across to my patients.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我试图向我的患者们传达的部分。

sentences.en: And I don't talk about my, my trauma necessarily with the patients.
sentences.zh: 我并不一定会在患者面前谈论我的创伤。

sentences.en: It's very rare actually, but it has definitely made an impact on how careful I am with people's pelvises.
sentences.zh: 其实非常罕见，但这绝对对我对待人们骨盆时有多小心产生了影响。

sentences.en: I don't take for granted, like doing vaginal ultrasounds.
sentences.zh: 我不会把做阴道超声当作理所当然的事。

sentences.en: I do that with permission.
sentences.zh: 我会在征得同意的情况下进行。

sentences.en: We talk it through.
sentences.zh: 我们会沟通商量。

sentences.en: They have, there's consent and you can stop at any time.
sentences.zh: 有知情同意的环节，而且你随时可以叫停。

sentences.en: I don't know that I would have been as careful with some of that practice and as careful with my words.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如果不是亲身经历过，我是不是在某些操作中会这么小心翼翼，在用词上会这么谨慎。

sentences.en: I would have liked to think I could have learned that without having to go through it.
sentences.zh: 我希望自己不用经历这一切也能学会这些。

sentences.en: But it definitely shaped my desire to give really good, safe care to someone and make them feel like I'm treating your body with respect.
sentences.zh: 但这确实塑造了我的愿望：为他人提供真正优质、安全的护理，让她们觉得我在尊重她们的身体。

sentences.en: And I'm still doing all of those things amidst this, like that's already difficult enough to do in Texas, even before SB8.
sentences.zh: 而且在这种情况之下，我仍然在做所有这些事情，就像在德州，甚至在SB8之前，这已经够难的了。

sentences.en: And then it's way more difficult during SB8 because it's a layer that I'm maintaining while also helping patients with all of the emotional layering on top.
sentences.zh: 然后在SB8期间就难得多，因为这是我一直在维持的一层压力，同时还要帮患者处理所有叠加的情绪。

sentences.en: And we're just looking ahead at maybe the biggest train wreck I've ever seen in my lifetime so far.
sentences.zh: 我们现在面临的可能是我这辈子见过最大的车祸现场。

sentences.en: And it's just going to get worse.
sentences.zh: 而且情况只会更糟。

sentences.en: Jess, we've talked to some folks on the anti-abortion side.
sentences.zh: 杰丝，我们和一些反堕胎人士聊过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And one thing that they were saying, a lot of people were saying was, you know, now is the moment when we really need to ramp up social services, diapers, help with transportation,
sentences.zh: 他们说的一点，很多人都在说，你知道，现在是我们需要真正加大社会服务力度的时候，比如尿布、交通协助，

sentences.en: that a lot more women are going to be carrying their pregnancies to term.
sentences.zh: 会有更多的女性将把她们的怀孕进行到底。

sentences.en: And we need to kind of be out there in force helping with that.
sentences.zh: 我们需要全力以赴地去提供帮助。

sentences.en: How do you see that argument?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看这种观点？

sentences.en: You know, if there was a robust social safety net, is there any world in which maybe this could actually work that, you know, you wouldn't necessarily need abortion,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果有一个健全的社会安全网，有没有可能这真的行得通，你知道，你实际上并不一定需要堕胎，

sentences.en: that it would be, you know, okay?
sentences.zh: 情况就会，你知道，没问题？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Actually, there's no world in which there aren't abortions.
sentences.zh: 事实上，根本不存在没有堕胎的世界。

sentences.en: And I actually wish I could get them to understand that.
sentences.zh: 我其实真希望他们能明白这一点。

sentences.en: Even if we give all the best birth control in the world and all of it works and no one has a failure, even if we give all of the best resources, we have Medicare for all,
sentences.zh: 即使我们提供世界上最好的避孕措施，且全部奏效，没有人避孕失败，即使我们提供最好的资源，我们有了全民医保，

sentences.en: even if we had all that, there will still be pregnancies where someone just doesn't want to continue it,
sentences.zh: 即使我们拥有这一切，仍然会有一些怀孕是有人就是不想继续下去的，

sentences.en: where someone has a fetal anomaly and decides that they would like to have an abortion.
sentences.zh: 有人遇到了胎儿畸形并决定他们想要堕胎。

sentences.en: As opposed to continuing to a delivery, because that feels better for them and their body and their choice.
sentences.zh: 而不是继续生下来，因为这对他们、他们的身体和他们的选择来说感觉更好。

sentences.en: The point that I really want them to understand is that having a delivery, taking a pregnancy all the way to term is at least 10 to 12 times more dangerous than having an abortion.
sentences.zh: 我真正想让他们明白的重点是，生孩子、把怀孕进行到足月，比堕胎危险至少10到12倍。

sentences.en: So when you tell me that I have to do that, that that's my job, that that's once I'm pregnant, that's what's required of me because there's a human being inside of me,
sentences.zh: 所以当你告诉我我必须这么做，这是我的工作，一旦我怀孕了，这就是对我的要求，因为我体内有一个人类，

sentences.en: you are sentencing me to a process that is 10 to 12 times more dangerous than the one I want.
sentences.zh: 你是在判处我去经历一个比我想要的危险10到12倍的过程。

sentences.en: You are possibly sentencing me to death or a uterine rupture or a rip during a C-section, something's cut, a problem with the intestines.
sentences.zh: 你可能是在判处我死刑、子宫破裂、剖腹产时撕裂、某些部位被切断，或是肠道出现问题。

sentences.en: I mean, pregnancy isn't a joke.
sentences.zh: 我是说，怀孕可不是闹着玩的。

sentences.en: It isn't easy.
sentences.zh: 它可不容易。

sentences.en: For some people it is.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说是的。

sentences.en: For some people it's incredibly hard.
sentences.zh: 但对某些人来说极其艰难。

sentences.en: And some people it's incredibly dangerous.
sentences.zh: 对有些人来说极其危险。

sentences.en: And none of that, none of that will change if Roe v.
sentences.zh: 而这些，所有这一切都不会改变，即使罗伊诉韦德案

sentences.en: Wade's overturned.
sentences.zh: 被推翻。

sentences.en: None of that will change even if everyone had all the resources they need.
sentences.zh: 即使每个人都拥有他们需要的所有资源，这一切也不会改变。

sentences.en: Jess, what do you wish that they understood?
sentences.zh: 杰丝，你希望他们明白什么？

sentences.en: I mean, the other side.
sentences.zh: 我是说，另一方。

sentences.en: I mean, if someone was sitting across from you right now, right now in your living room and you were trying to get your point across to them, what would you be saying to them?
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果有人现在正坐在你对面，就在你的客厅里，而你正试图把你的观点传达给他们，你会对他们说些什么？

sentences.en: I would say to them, it's okay if you personally believe that an abortion is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我会对他们说，如果你个人认为堕胎是错的，没关系。

sentences.en: You do not have to have an abortion.
sentences.zh: 你不需要去堕胎。

sentences.en: No one is asking you to.
sentences.zh: 没有人要求你这么做。

sentences.en: What we are asking you is to not decide for other people what medical care is best for them.
sentences.zh: 我们要求你的是，不要替其他人决定什么样的医疗护理对他们最好。

sentences.en: It does not matter what you actually think about it.
sentences.zh: 你实际上是怎么想的并不重要。

sentences.en: It doesn't actually matter that you turn to God for that information.
sentences.zh: 你为了寻求那种信息而转向上帝，其实也并不重要。

sentences.en: That's for you.
sentences.zh: 那是你自己的事。

sentences.en: That isn't for others.
sentences.zh: 那不是别人的事。

sentences.en: One of the most basic things we learn about in medicine, we have to take patients seriously.
sentences.zh: 我们在医学中学到的最基础的事情之一，就是我们必须认真对待患者。

sentences.en: I can't force you to do something with your body.
sentences.zh: 我不能强迫你用你的身体去做某事。

sentences.en: This is forced birth, not just outlawing abortions.
sentences.zh: 这是强制生育，而不仅仅是取缔堕胎。

sentences.en: It's pushing people into dangerous places.
sentences.zh: 这是把人们推向危险的境地。

sentences.en: I mean, do you see it in some way just fundamentally, like these two positions are just fundamentally incompatible?
sentences.zh: 我是说，从某种程度上你是否认为，从根本上讲，这两种立场就是完全水火不容的？

sentences.en: It's like it has to be one or the other.
sentences.zh: 就像必须二选一一样。

sentences.en: It can't, like where is the compromise?
sentences.zh: 不能，折中点在哪里呢？

sentences.en: Is there a compromise anywhere in this?
sentences.zh: 这其中有什么折中的余地吗？

sentences.en: No, I really don't think so.
sentences.zh: 不，我真的不这么认为。

sentences.en: It's not their body.
sentences.zh: 这不是他们的身体。

sentences.en: Like I really, I think it's as basic as that.
sentences.zh: 就像我真的觉得，事情就这么基础。

sentences.en: And I think when we get tangled up in everything else, it's just more confusing, but it really comes down to something really basic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当我们陷入其他所有事情中时，只会更让人糊涂，但它确实归结为非常基础的东西。

sentences.en: I do not consider it acceptable to be a quote unquote pro-life physician.
sentences.zh: 我认为当一个所谓的“反堕胎”医生是不可接受的。

sentences.en: I do not consider that acceptable because if you believe that you know better what I should do with my pregnancy than I do,
sentences.zh: 我认为这不可接受，因为如果你认为你比我更清楚我该如何处理我的怀孕，

sentences.en: then who's to say you won't make that choice for me in other medical settings?
sentences.zh: 那么谁说你不会在其他医疗情况下也为我做决定？

sentences.en: You won't withhold a blood transfusion because you don't think I need it.
sentences.zh: 你不会因为觉得我不需要而拒绝输血。

sentences.en: You won't withhold another medication because you don't like where it was manufactured.
sentences.zh: 你不会因为不喜欢某个药的产地而拒绝另一种药物。

sentences.en: Like where does that, where does that line stop?
sentences.zh: 就像这条线到底在哪里停止？

sentences.en: I don't think it's acceptable as a human being really to be anti-choice because you are telling someone that you think that you know better about themselves than themselves.
sentences.zh: 作为一个正常人，反堕胎真的不可接受，因为你在告诉别人，你觉得自己比他们更了解他们自己。

sentences.en: That's insane.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: That just doesn't have a place in our society, period.
sentences.zh: 这在我们的社会中根本没有立足之地，绝对没有。

sentences.en: But Jess, what about you?
sentences.zh: 但是杰丝，你呢？

sentences.en: I mean, are you thinking that maybe you would need to leave the state?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你是不是在考虑也许你得离开这个州？

sentences.en: Is that something that's been weighing on your mind?
sentences.zh: 这件事一直在你脑海里挥之不去吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对有。

sentences.en: It's, um, you know, the way I look at it is I feel like we're in a battle here.
sentences.zh: 这，嗯，你知道，我的看法是，我觉得我们这里正在打仗。

sentences.en: I imagine that's kind of what it feels like now in New Mexico with the wait times and just how desperate people are.
sentences.zh: 我想新墨西哥州现在由于等待时间和人们的绝望情绪，大概也就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: And when we're so close to somewhere that needs help and I have the procedural skills to safely help, it's harder to sit here and not do that.
sentences.zh: 当我们离一个需要帮助的地方这么近，而我又有安全提供帮助的手术技能时，坐在这里却什么都不做就更难了。

sentences.en: It feels hard for me to stay.
sentences.zh: 我觉得留在这里很难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But I am, I am also really tied to the patients I see here.
sentences.zh: 但我，我也确实和我在见到的患者有着很深的羁绊。

sentences.en: And I do, I have some patients that have seen me more than once that I know trust me.
sentences.zh: 而且确实，我有些患者见我不止一次，我知道他们信任我。

sentences.en: And so it's also hard to think about leaving.
sentences.zh: 所以要考虑离开也很难。

sentences.en: I really hate this position that I've been put in.
sentences.zh: 我真的很讨厌我被置于这种处境。

sentences.en: It's, it's, it's confusing.
sentences.zh: 这，这，这太让人困惑了。

sentences.en: Like I shouldn't really be in this position, I don't think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我本来就不该落入这种境地。

sentences.en: What does it feel like Jess to have to make that choice?
sentences.zh: 杰丝，不得不做出那样的选择是什么感觉？

sentences.en: It feels unbelievable, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，感觉难以置信。

sentences.en: I didn't think that we would in my lifetime.
sentences.zh: 我没想到在我们有生之年会遇到这种事。

sentences.en: I thought that I would just hear the stories from the movements across the last century and I would just like learn from those.
sentences.zh: 我以为我只会听到上个世纪各种运动的故事，然后从中吸取教训就行了。

sentences.en: And I have, I feel like, okay, we've learned from these.
sentences.zh: 而我也确实这么做了，我觉得，好吧，我们已经从这些中吸取了教训。

sentences.en: Like we got to be on top of our game.
sentences.zh: 我们要保持最佳状态。

sentences.en: We got to make sure that we're voting.
sentences.zh: 我们要确保我们去投票。

sentences.en: But like somehow it wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 但不知怎么的，这还不够。

sentences.en: And we didn't, we didn't stop this from happening.
sentences.zh: 我们没有，我们没能阻止这一切发生。

sentences.en: And it feels devastating.
sentences.zh: 这让人感觉太毁灭了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Elon Musk, the billionaire CEO of Tesla, who struck a deal last month to buy Twitter, said he would, quote,
sentences.zh: 周二，特斯拉亿万富翁首席执行官埃隆·马斯克上个月达成了收购推特的协议，他表示他将，引用原话，

sentences.zh: 撤销对前总统唐纳德·特朗普的永久禁令，让他重返该平台。

sentences.en: It was not correct to ban Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 封禁唐纳德·特朗普是不正确的。

sentences.en: I think that was, that was a mistake because it, it alienated a large part of the country and did not ultimately result in Donald Trump not having a voice.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是，那是个错误，因为它疏远了这个国家很大一部分人，并且最终没有阻止唐纳德·特朗普发出自己的声音。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump was banned from Twitter in January of 2021 after the attack by his followers on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生于2021年1月在他的追随者冲击美国

sentences.en: Capitol building.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦后被推特封禁。

sentences.zh: 马斯克的言论预示着他可能会对推特进行的彻底变革，预计他将在未来六个月内接管推特。

sentences.en: And a new CDC report shows that gun deaths in 2020 reached the highest number ever recorded in the United States.
sentences.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心的一份新报告显示，2020年的枪支死亡人数达到了美国有史以来的最高记录。

sentences.en: More than 45,000 Americans died that year in gun-related incidents.
sentences.zh: 当年有超过45000名美国人死于与枪支相关的事件。

sentences.zh: 与枪支相关的谋杀案上升了35%，是现代历史上最大的一次单年增幅。

sentences.en: Experts said that the elevated toll could be related to stressors associated with the pandemic or to a rise in gun ownership that happened ahead of the presidential election.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，死亡人数的飙升可能与大流行带来的压力有关，也可能与总统大选前枪支拥有量的上升有关。
